tasks.label: colcon build
tasks.command: [ -f /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash ] && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; colcon build --symlink-install --cmake-args -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && jq -s 'add' build/*/compile_commands.json > build/compile_commands.json

tasks.label: colcon build (this package)
tasks.command: [ -f /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash ] && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; colcon build --symlink-install --packages-select ${input:pkg} --cmake-args -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && jq -s 'add' build/*/compile_commands.json > build/compile_commands.json
